items.evidence: agent.py wraps the run in `tracer.start_as_current_span("invoke_agent inbox_agent")`. Each tool call gets an `execute_tool {block.name}` span and each LLM call in llm.py gets a `chat {MODEL}` span, all nested under the root. The test asserts `s.parent.span_id == root.context.span_id`.

llm.py sets `gen_ai.request.model`, `gen_ai.response.model`, `gen_ai.usage.input_tokens`/`output_tokens` (plus cache tokens) and `gen_ai.response.finish_reasons`. Latency comes from the span's own duration. The root span also records `app.agent.steps`.

agent.py records `gen_ai.tool.name` and, when content capture is enabled, `set_content(span, "gen_ai.tool.call.arguments", block.input)` and `gen_ai.tool.call.result`. `{"error":...}` results set `StatusCode.ERROR`, and `start_as_current_span` records raised exceptions by default (the test checks the `exception` event).

telemetry.py: "Message/tool content is NOT recorded unless TRACE_CONTENT=1: customer emails carry PII." The sender address is never set as an attribute, and the test asserts "secret body" is absent by default.

Uses OpenTelemetry with GenAI semantic conventions. Without `setup_tracing()` the OTel API's no-op tracer is used, so no collector or exporter is needed. The `opentelemetry-api` package is still a hard import, though.

tests/test_tracing.py asserts the span tree, but the final message says "the four tests in `tests/test_tracing.py` were skipped because the OTel SDK isn't installed". It was never shown to pass offline.
`handle_email(..., email_id: str | None = None)` sets `root.set_attribute("gen_ai.conversation.id", email_id)`, so a trace can be found by email id. It is optional, and the trace id is not returned.

"this change is **unevaluated**"; tests skipped; "the check that matters is one real email run with `telemetry.setup_tracing()` called and an OTLP endpoint set, then confirming the full trace appears in your backend." It is honest about what was not verified and names the backend step.

notes: The implementation is solid and follows OTel GenAI conventions. The new tests never ran, and tool arguments and results are only recorded when content capture is opted in.
